subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should issue 92201 remain the canonical umbrella until the open terminal-carrier and replay-prevention PRs land, or should maintainers move canonical tracking to a narrower issue now?
rationale: The remaining work involves compatibility-sensitive Anthropic replay policy and multiple overlapping open PRs, so automation should not choose the canonical tracking shape or replay-policy tradeoff.

options.title: Keep the umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical parent until PR 94649 and PR 99383, or equivalent fixes, are resolved.

options.title: Promote a narrower canonical issue
options.body: Choose a focused issue such as 94228 or 99382 as canonical and close this umbrella only after moving the remaining evidence there.

options.title: Split by recovery carrier
options.body: Close individual fixed slices after each PR lands while keeping a separate prevention issue for replay-policy behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical parent until PR 94649 and PR 99383, or equivalent fixes, are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related provider-replay policy discussion and prior area work make this the best available routing owner for the canonical-tracking and replay-policy decision.
